inspiration: One shared pickup gate per item kind: weapons always taken, ammo refused at a cap, health refused at max, power-ups always taken. Keep one shared rule the client predicts and the server confirms; ours is server-verified with per-kind data fields.

Item rows that carry the whole item: name, pickup cue, icon, world model and type in one row. Keep one row per item with its cues together; change the rows to point at our catalogue with rarity colour and a sound key.

Hovering power-up pickup: the entity is marked as suspended so it floats above the ground and is seen at a glance. Keep the hover and the single pickup cue; change the shape to a ring of light with a per-power glow.
Single-light radius shadow: a shadow pass needs one light origin and a radius. Keep one light and one radius; on phones bake a soft disc and cap the lights at two.
Depth-only crease darkening: a screen-space pass that needs only depth and view info. Keep the cheap contact darkening; gate it behind the quality tier.
Two HUD presets chosen by a loaded list: a full and a minimal layout. Keep the minimal preset as a switch; our layout keeps bars in the thumb zone at 375 wide.
Bone-only creature storage: vertices attach to bones so each frame stores bone positions only. Keep bone-only frame data for creature clips; use our own rig and bone names.
